passed: The named NIH funding mechanism and grant align with the clinical AI purposes.
The 50000-admission snapshot, earlier lower bound of over 45000 admissions, and future 100000-admission target are distinguished without asserting contradictory counts.
The imaging observations retain their different units and potentially different observation dates.
Controlled dataset access is kept separate from the GitHub project's MIT license.
EEG extraction, labeling, deidentification, and holdout provisioning are qualified as planned or in progress where appropriate.
warnings: Ethical oversight, consent, and current deidentification effectiveness cannot be assessed from the documented plans.
Processing reproducibility and released-data lineage cannot be assessed without workflow versions and derivation records.
The applicability of the training-program access process to other requesters is explicitly unresolved.

issues_detected.description: Five of the 14 Q1 fields are absent, including structured variables and confidentiality classification.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add supported variable metadata, confidentiality information, identifiers, and any actual dataset relationships; do not invent relationships solely to populate fields.

issues_detected.description: Planned or in-progress deidentification and enclave access do not establish ethical oversight, consent arrangements, or current released-data privacy protections.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document applicable review or waiver decisions, consent or waiver arrangements, implemented deidentification methods, reidentification risks, and protections for represented vulnerable groups.

issues_detected.description: License and access instructions apply to one training program. General requester eligibility, operative terms, confidentiality classification, decision authority, and a direct access portal are not established.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide the applicable dataset agreement and access portal, identify the decision-making body, and document eligibility, confidentiality, and relevant regulatory obligations for each access route.

issues_detected.description: Processing tools and strategies are named without software versions, reproducible configurations, or comprehensive cleaning, annotation-quality, and missing-data procedures.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document implemented workflow steps, tool releases and resolvable software references, inputs and outputs, and applicable quality and missing-data handling.

issues_detected.description: Retrospective extraction is described without collection windows or identified site-level collectors and responsibilities.
issues_detected.recommendation: Specify patient-data collection periods, contributing sites and roles, source systems, and implemented extraction procedures.

issues_detected.description: No dataset release identifier, change history, maintenance assignment, or preservation commitment is documented.
issues_detected.recommendation: Identify the assessed release and its durable access route, then document change tracking, maintenance responsibility, and preservation arrangements.

issues_detected.description: The record lists multiple supporting resources but lacks a formal dataset citation.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide a recommended citation identifying the dataset title, authors or publishing organization, release, and available identifier.

issues_detected.description: Care settings and admission totals are described without demographic distributions, subgroup counts, or implemented eligibility criteria.
issues_detected.recommendation: Describe the released cohort's inclusion and exclusion rules, demographic and clinical distributions, site representation, and relevant missingness.

issues_detected.description: Intended uses and an agreement requirement are present, but detailed reuse permissions, prohibited or discouraged uses, and social-impact risks and mitigations are absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document operative reuse permissions and restrictions, deployment limitations, foreseeable harms, and concrete mitigation guidance.

issues_detected.description: Document-source provenance and high-level processing descriptions do not establish release history or a complete clinical-data derivation chain. The only split description is prospective.
issues_detected.recommendation: Connect identified source entities, extraction and transformation activities, responsible agents, quality checks, and released outputs in text or a provenance graph; document implemented splits and release changes.

issues_detected.description: Diversity and equity ambitions are not accompanied by identification of observed or anticipated dataset biases and downstream consequences.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document supported selection, representation, measurement, and site-related limitations, their consequences for intended uses, and appropriate fairness analyses and mitigations.

issues_detected.description: The external resource address www.bridge2ai.org/chorus lacks a URL scheme.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide a fully qualified URL after confirming the intended address.

semantic_insights: The record carefully distinguishes current observations, lower bounds, future targets, and planned processing instead of presenting them as a single completed release.
Admissions, unique patients, images, EHR rows, and waveform volume are distinguished rather than treated as interchangeable counts.
Funding attribution is specific, and named creators have institutional affiliations.
Standard formats, OMOP common-model conformance, and semantic-mapping resources provide substantive interoperability evidence.
Source caveats appropriately prevent a GitHub project license from being assigned to the clinical dataset.
Detailed documentation provenance strengthens interpretability but does not replace dataset-level lineage, ethics, maintenance, or bias documentation.
